_: One person, several 등록번호. The portal hands an entrant without a registration a throwaway id (98…, no profile at all), so a player can hold one real number and a temporary one per event. 'merge' is applied by tools/build-ladder.mts: every id in `ids` is rewritten to the first one before anything is rated. 'review' is NOT applied — same name and birth year, but the evidence does not settle it.
